paragraphs: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics ke taaza haftawar data ke mutabiq mulk bhar mein **aata** phir mehnga ho gaya hai.
Sab se bara izafa **Bannu** mein hua, jahan 20 kilo ka thaila ek hafte mein **Rs 400** mehnga ho kar Rs 3,300 ka ho gaya.
Islamabad, Karachi aur Peshawar mein 20 kilo aata ab **Rs 3,400** ka mil raha hai. Rawalpindi mein Rs 347 ka izafa hua.
Lahore (**Rs 2,300**) aur Faisalabad (**Rs 2,200**) mein qeemat is hafte nahi badli.
question: Aap ke shehar mein aata kitne ka hai?
